configurations.//: Serves the existing production build. Use this to check anything that behaves differently in a real build — middleware responses, static generation, prerendered HTML. Calls the local next binary directly because pnpm 11 on this machine runs an install first and fails on the build-script approval prompt, while CI is pinned to pnpm 10. Run `next build` first.
configurations.name: portfolio-prod

configurations.//: Production build with /tools switched on. The only way to verify the WASM codecs honestly: dev serves them through webpack's on-the-fly asset pipeline, while a real build hashes and emits them as static files, and it is the second one that ships. Build with NEXT_PUBLIC_TOOLS_LIVE=1 first or every /tools route answers 410.
configurations.name: portfolio-tools-prod

configurations.//: Dev server with the retired /tools section switched on, so it can be worked on and clicked through locally while production stays dark. Calls the local next binary directly: pnpm 11 runs an install first and CI is pinned to pnpm 10.
configurations.name: portfolio-tools
